comment: Everything a body can take beyond its look, from any source: a blood's marks (data/bloods.json, marks), the rank's trim, the bonded genius's colour, the changes of instars. kind: part (a model from game/assets/people/parts/<part>.glb at each socket bone), tint (blended into the skin tone by strength), eyes (the iris colour, with emission), glow (emissive skin and a light), trim and cape (applied by the game). Built by tools/blender/body_kit.py parts. shapeColor names which colour the hero's Shape overrides (trim, iris, glow). Derived features: World.features_of adds eyes-genius and skin-field from the genius's instar, trim-journeyman is written at the Gate, cloak-genius when a genius is born.

eyes-cat.label: eyes that shine like a cat's

glow-under-skin.label: a glow under the skin at night

trim-journeyman.label: the Journeyman's trim at the collar, in the archetype's colour
trim-journeyman.cutUntilFits: Hung on the head's socket at the throat, a stiff piece made for a bare neck: on a dressed body a third to a half of it is under the collar, the scarf or the shoulder cape, and it turns with the head, not the shoulders (docs/dress-fit.md).

cloak-genius.label: the bonded genius's colour threading the cloak

eyes-genius.label: the genius's light in the eyes (from its second instar)

skin-field.label: the field under the skin (from the third instar)

echo-ruff.label: a ruff at the collar in its genius's coat (a Beast's echo, from the Third Form)
echo-ruff.cutUntilFits: Hung on the head's socket at the throat, a stiff piece made for a bare neck: on a dressed body a third to a half of it is under the collar, the scarf or the shoulder cape, and it turns with the head, not the shoulders (docs/dress-fit.md).

echo-charm.label: a charm at the throat that its genius made (a Kith's echo)
echo-charm.cutUntilFits: Hung on the head's socket at the throat, a stiff piece made for a bare neck: on a dressed body a third to a half of it is under the collar, the scarf or the shoulder cape, and it turns with the head, not the shoulders (docs/dress-fit.md).

echo-gorget.label: a gorget of its genius's metal (an Engine's or a Relic's echo)
echo-gorget.cutUntilFits: Hung on the head's socket at the throat, a stiff piece made for a bare neck: on a dressed body a third to a half of it is under the collar, the scarf or the shoulder cape, and it turns with the head, not the shoulders (docs/dress-fit.md).

echo-brand.label: a brand over the heart that burns in its field's colour (a Daemon's echo)

echo-motes.label: motes of its field that keep to its shoulders (an Aspect's echo)
